methodology.record_note: Coordinate network trained only on the official aoa_train regime of the public release (700 of the 804 cases), the regime this split defines. Predictions are made at the native internal points of every official test case, so the mapping to the domain support is the identity and no interpolation of the benchmark side occurs.

architecture.description: Point-wise multilayer perceptron: 4 hidden layers of width 256 with SiLU activations, 201219 trainable parameters, three outputs per point (u/U_inf, v/U_inf, p/U_inf^2).

components.role: maps point features to the three flow quantities
components.description: 11 input channels, hidden width and depth as declared, 3 outputs

key_hyperparameters.name: hidden layers
key_hyperparameters.description: SiLU blocks before the output layer

key_hyperparameters.name: epochs
key_hyperparameters.description: passes over the sampled training point set

key_hyperparameters.name: wall sampling share
key_hyperparameters.description: share of each case's sample taken from the wall and the boundary-layer band

input_features.name: point position
input_features.description: x and y in metres, divided by the chord.

input_features.name: distance to the airfoil
input_features.description: the AirfRANS signed distance per point, divided by the chord, and its signed logarithm.

input_features.name: wall normals
input_features.description: the airfoil normal at the nearest wall point, zero away from the wall.

input_features.name: wall mask
input_features.description: 1 on an airfoil node, 0 elsewhere (the AirfRANS surface flag).

input_features.name: freestream direction
input_features.description: unit inlet velocity, i.e. the case's angle of attack.

input_features.name: inlet velocity
input_features.description: log of the inlet velocity magnitude (the case's Reynolds-like scale).

predicted_fields.description: Cartesian velocity on every native 2D flow-domain point.
Kinematic pressure on every native 2D flow-domain point.
Curve pressure selected from the domain prediction at the wall, as the methodology contract allows.

data_handling.normalization: per-point scaling by the chord and the inlet velocity: positions and distances divide by the chord, velocity by U_inf, pressure by U_inf^2. No dataset-wide statistics are used, so the same weights transfer across cases.
data_handling.preprocessing: the public AirfRANS preprocessing (cropped domain, airfoil curve, signed distance, wall normals) read through the AirfRANS 0.1.5.1 library; the native point order is preserved end to end.
data_handling.sampling: 4096 points per training case, a quarter of them from the wall and the boundary-layer band, resampled every epoch over 700 training cases; every native point of every official test case is predicted for inference, in memory-safe chunks.

stages.description: supervised regression on the official training split of the public AirfRANS release; no test data and no external pretraining.

loss.description: mean squared error over the three scaled outputs (u/U_inf, v/U_inf, p/U_inf^2) of the sampled points
loss.weighting: uniform mean over every component and sampled point

optimizers.name: AdamW
optimizers.schedule: cosine decay to lr/50, weight decay 1e-5

compute.hardware: Apple M-series integrated GPU (Metal/MPS), one device, one process
compute.measurement_notes: one process on one device; wall-clock of the training script, 172.8 s measured end to end.

checkpoints.bytes_description: 808613 bytes, torch state dict of the trained network
checkpoints.role: the trained weights loaded for every prediction
checkpoints.selection_rule: the final epoch of the single run; no checkpoint selection was performed

inference_compute.measurement_notes: wall time of the prediction campaign over the complete official split: feature construction, chunked forward passes and packing of every case's native-order arrays. Model load and framework import are excluded.

evaluation.command: python scripts/airfrans.py evaluate-entry <entry> --dataset-root <Dataset> --support-root <support> --output <work/result> --resume; python scripts/airfrans.py package --evaluation-root <work/result>/evaluation --config <entry>/package-config.json --discretization-cases <entry>/discretization-cases.jsonl --output submissions/airfrans/pp-coordinate-net-aoa-train-v1

note: AirfRANS submission; forces and profiles are derived from the predicted native fields.
